locations.name: Ledger Hall
locations.description: Magistrate Orr studies a map of the barrier beneath cracked glass.

locations.name: Flood Market
locations.description: Stallholders lift their wares above the tide line. A trader offers a stolen name.

locations.name: Old Quay
locations.description: Names scratched from the quay stones lead to a collector's broken cart.

locations.name: Breakwater Engine
locations.description: The storm engine consumes names in a blue and windless flame.

locations.name: Reed Ferry
locations.description: Neri poles a boat through reeds hung with mourning ribbons.

locations.name: Salt Orchard
locations.description: Collectors have stacked tablets beneath drowned trees.

locations.name: Silt Shrine
locations.description: Empty bowls remember passengers lost between the banks.

locations.name: Drowned Archive
locations.description: Preserved testimony reveals what the engine does to a name.

locations.name: Switchback
locations.description: Wind hums through abandoned conductor wires.

locations.name: Bell Foundry
locations.description: Striking workers have banked the furnaces.

locations.name: Miners' Rest
locations.description: Sable tends the injured in a crowded bunkhouse.

locations.name: Wind Cairn
locations.description: A damaged vent could redirect wind to the foundry.

locations.name: Pilgrim Gate
locations.description: Pilgrims leave their shoes at a gate of tablet fragments.

locations.name: Ossuary Steps
locations.description: Pell recognises a warrant nailed above a collector's cache.

locations.name: Empty Basilica
locations.description: A single bell hangs above pews worn smooth by waiting families.

locations.name: Storm Mouth
locations.description: The Cantor holds the last seal at the edge of a roaring chasm.

quests.title: The Ferry's Due
quests.brief: Decide where the seized names belong.

quests.title: The Last Account
quests.brief: Confront the custodian and decide the future.

endings.title: Keep the Barrier
endings.text: Tern keeps burning the names. The wall holds while the families mourn a second time.

endings.title: Return the Names
endings.text: The names go home. Tern evacuates beneath a failing wall.

endings.title: Shared Covenant
endings.text: The testimony and workers' wind conductors let city and families share the burden.
